brief.text: Closed-end funds show noticeable concentration in cluster activity, with BPRE, NXG, and CRAFX each drawing three buyers, led by BPRE's $34,938,925 total. FUL stands out for insider breadth, attracting purchases from an unusually high eight individual buyers totaling $1,123,318. The largest overall group transaction occurred at BORR with $57,144,458 across three insiders, while individual filings were topped by LYCA with a $37,653,863 purchase by Venrock Healthcare Capital Partners, followed closely by a $28,984,170 buy in MSM by director Mitchell Jacobson.
